import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

PRODUCTS = ['Product' + str(i) for i in range(1, 6)]
MONTHS = ['Month' + str(i) for i in range(1, 13)]

def task_func():
    # Generate random sales data
    sales_data = np.random.randint(10, 1000, size=(len(MONTHS), len(PRODUCTS)))
    
    # Create DataFrame
    df = pd.DataFrame(sales_data, index=MONTHS, columns=PRODUCTS)
    
    # Calculate total sales per product
    total_sales = df.sum()
    
    # Initialize subplots for visualization
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))
    
    # 1. Line plot showing the total sales per product
    ax1.plot(total_sales.index, total_sales.values, marker='o', linestyle='-', color='b')
    ax1.set_title('Total Sales per Product')
    ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
    ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales')
    ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
    
    # 2. Heatmap visualizing sales figures across products and months
    sns.heatmap(df, ax=ax2, cmap="YlGnBu", annot=True, fmt="d", cbar_kws={'label': 'Sales'})
    ax2.set_title('Monthly Sales Figures')
    ax2.set_xlabel('Product')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Month')
    ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    
    # Display the plots
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
    
    return df
